card.name: Leap-year rule wording "divisible by"
card.fires_on: The word "by" in the leap-year rule "divisible by 100 but not divisible by 400", and digits inside year numbers in calendar text. It also fires weakly on scattered other words, such as "events" and the start of "Sch" names.

modes.label: Leap-year rule
modes.description: The word "by" after "divisible" in the Gregorian leap-year rule, or digits inside the year numbers that follow.

modes.label: Words after "these" or "such"
modes.description: A noun such as "events" or "monitoring" right after "these" or "such" in label text.
modes.example: The mechanism and long-term consequences of these<< events>> are currently unknown.

modes.label: Start of Sch- words
modes.description: The opening piece of a word beginning with "Sch", such as a surname in a reference list or "Schizophrenia".
modes.example: Child & Family Behavior Therapy, 23, 1-20. <<Sch>>uhmann, E., Foote,
